definitions.explanation: Something that has just come into being or is being done for the first time.
Starting again with a fresh perspective or approach.

examples.japanese: {新|あら}たな{問題|もんだい}が{出|で}た。
{新|あら}たな{計画|けいかく}を{立|た}てた。
{新|あら}たな{気持|きも}ちで{仕事|しごと}に{取|と}り{組|く}みたい。
examples.english: I want to approach work with a fresh mindset.

examples.japanese: {新|あら}たに{始|はじ}めましょう。
{気持|きも}ちを{新|あら}たにする。
{新年|しんねん}を{迎|むか}え、{決意|けつい}を{新|あら}たにした。
examples.english: As the new year began, I renewed my determination.

notes:
{新|あら}た is a na-adjective meaning new or fresh.

FORMS:
- Adverbial: {新|あら}たに (newly, afresh)
- Noun modifier: {新|あら}たな + noun

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {新|あら}たな{出発|しゅっぱつ} (fresh start)
- {新|あら}たに{始|はじ}める (start anew)
- {気持|きも}ちを{新|あら}たにする (refresh one's attitude)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {新|あたら}しい: new (i-adjective, common)
- {新|あら}た: new (na-adjective, more literary/formal)
- フレッシュ: fresh (loanword)
